scientific_estimand_checks: Fix target and sign before simulation: E_seed[sqrt(E_time(error_rival^2))-sqrt(E_time(error_candidate^2))]; distinguish fixed-calendar conditional targets from process targets.
H0 theta<=delta versus H1 theta>delta; delta practical margin differs from planning alternative Delta_alt>delta.
Do not replace the mean of individual-seed RMSEs with pooled MSE, RMSE of averaged predictions, an ensemble metric, a rank estimand or conditional GW omnibus significance.

All claimed primary tests must address the declared target and include justified seed, calendar and interaction uncertainty. Dates bootstrap alone and t over seeds alone do not generally establish both.
Horizon1 does not remove seven-return target overlap or other autocorrelation. Nesting must be justified before Clark-West. HLN implementation/assumptions must match forecast horizon.
A named Table4 method still needs an explicit mathematically valid adaptation. Any adaptation outside the named family remains pending admissibility, not approved by naming.
controlled_validation_checks: Preserve timestamped plan, source hash, fixed scenarios/seeds/budgets and pass/fail criteria before execution; retain all failed and adverse cases.
Population/DGP truth must be known or independently established; finite sample truth is not a substitute for a population RMSE target.
Calibrate boundary null theta=delta, interior nulls and partial-null families with dependence across rivals; record per-test typeI, intersection decision and FWER of true-null rejections.
Exercise temporal autocorrelation/common shocks, seed random effects, crossed seed-time variation, heterogeneous scales and heavy tails within stated assumptions.
Report interval coverage of the declared unconditional target, with MonteCarlo precision. Toy fixture success alone is software validation.

Cover insufficient R/T, zero/near-zero variance, non-finite inputs, perfect ties, constant series, negative errors versus nonnegative losses, invalid margins, missing rivals/panels and deterministic rivals.
Use the declared full family in every replicate, with identical candidate/common calendar and paired seeds; do not assume joint power equals product of marginals.
Multiplicity across panels/procedures/metrics/secondary decisions must be declared before results; if families are separate, do not advertise a global 0.05 bound without further control.
Increasing T must not erase persistent seed variance; increasing R must not erase persistent shared calendar uncertainty.
Passing controlled scenarios is conditional calibration for those DGPs and resources, not proof for market processes, sufficient finalR/T, confirmation or R3.
